create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 intact Mellin--Euler signed-moment reduction and fixed-polylogarithmic-L sector
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), y=floor(J), q_X=X/y^2, H=floor(yX^(-1/4))=sqrt(J)+O(1), and 1<<L<<H. Retain the complete literal selector-free hard-TOP t=1 scalar with every accepted shell, profile, real-centre floor, star, cone edge, endpoint transition, parity branch, and zero extension. Its intact squarefree, coprime, odd-first-leg series factors for Re(s_1),Re(s_2)>1 as D(s_1,s_2)=L(s_1,chi_4)zeta(s_2)G(s_1,s_2), where G_2=1-2^(-2s_2), G_p=(1+x_p+y_p)(1-x_p)(1-y_p) for odd p, x_p=chi_4(p)p^(-s_1), y_p=p^(-s_2), and G is holomorphic by absolute local-uniform convergence for Re(s_1),Re(s_2)>1/2. An exact disjoint-cardinal Mellin interpolation gives, for every fixed 0<eta<1/4, S_(L,1)=R_zeta+I_eta with R_zeta<<_epsilon L^2J^(-1)X^epsilon, so the general target is equivalent up to a target-safe term to I_eta<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. Given a requested final epsilon, choose eta after epsilon and an auxiliary delta still smaller. In a favorable recombined smooth/BV capacity model, not a unit cardinal cell, the transform has scale L^(2eta)sqrt(L/J) over radial length JL; unweighted pointwise absolute control or the stated fixed-angular mean square plus Cauchy has L^(2eta)sqrt(J)L^(3/2)X^delta capacity and retains a structural sqrt(J) deficit. This is neither an estimate nor a lower bound for the exact cardinal integral and does not rule out a bespoke signed weighted theorem. For every fixed B>0, L<=(log X)^B implies S_(L,1)<<_(epsilon,B)L^(3/2)X^epsilon. For every fixed kappa>0, exact subtraction of the accepted kappa-dependent close-opposite-prime XOR sector gives the same fixed-polylogarithmic-L bound for S_(L,1;kappa)^rem with constant depending on kappa. The polynomial-L full scalar and residual, every other hard-TOP channel, all parents and bridges, the quarter theorem, and both exponent ledgers remain open or unchanged.
create.next_action: Prove the exact signed two-height bound for non-polylogarithmic L, retaining the cardinal-cell complexity or replacing it only by a separately proved endpoint-lawful transform with quantified seminorms. Do not repeat the named absolute placements, assert an FE/AFE self-return, or infer a physical bound from positive collar capacity.

update.next_action: Use the Round-168 reduction to regard every fixed-B polylogarithmic-L t=1 scalar as owned. For the non-polylogarithmic t=1 range, prove the exact signed two-height estimate or an equivalent literal physical estimate, and retain every other hard-TOP channel and collar.

reject.reason: Fixed B gives only L<=(log X)^B=X^o(1), and the residual corollary also fixes kappa; the polynomial-L scalar and general residual remain open.
The stationary scale belongs only to a favorable recombined smooth/BV capacity model; the exact cardinal identity has O(L^2) unit cells and different bandwidths.
Even the granted unweighted Lindelof placement or stated fixed-angular mean square plus Cauchy has L^(2eta)sqrt(J)L^(3/2)X^delta capacity and misses the target by sqrt(J).
No G-coefficient, two-adic, gamma, main-term, truncation, error, or literal-profile bridge is proved; only deliberate reopening of the accepted projector invokes the prior collar.
The cardinal residue is a continuous oscillatory integral and is O(L^2/J), whereas the exact mixed-difference residue telescopes to a discrete weighted sum and is not automatically small.
The no-go is confined to the two named absolute placements and the dated audited source interfaces; a bespoke signed weighted theorem remains possible.

The non-polylogarithmic t=1 scalar, residual, other hard-TOP channels, BAL, UNBAL, both direct M1 parents, GAR, endpoint assembly, M9-M2, M9, both bridges, and the quarter theorem remain open, so neither exponent ledger changes.
